paragraphs.text: Islam, sanity, reaching the age of discernment, being in a state of ritual purity, removal of najāsah (tangible impurity), covering the ‘awrah (parts of the body that must be covered during the prayer), commencement of the prayer time, facing the qiblah (direction of the Ka‘bah), and the intention.

source.title: IMPORTANT LESSONS FOR THE GENERAL UMMAH
